# GhostHand

**Category:** Exploit  
**Aliases:** Ghost Hand, GhostHand

## What it does

GhostHand lets you open and interact with certain blocks even when they're hidden behind walls, floors, or other obstacles. Normally Minecraft blocks your line of sight, so you can't right-click a container you can't actually see — GhostHand removes that limitation for the blocks you've chosen, letting you reach containers tucked away inside builds or behind cover.

Description basis: [publisher description](https://liquidbounce.net/docs/modules/exploit/ghosthand). The module's behavior on a stock Minecraft 26.3 server has not been verified unless separately documented in [research](../../RESEARCH.md).
